svg.title: FoveaWAM: real-scene role-aware geometry and Native success versus latency
svg.desc: Left: P040 RGB photograph with a translucent copy of the target and cart to illustrate the past. Projected, time-colored sparse 3D flow arrows and the target SE(3) pose trajectory are illustrative. A separate staged P043 photograph shows the gripper on the target. Right: Native SR and native p95 from Table 1. FoveaWAM reports 82.1% and 15.1 ms. A single diagonal comparison points from OpenWAM-alpha to FoveaWAM; its label reports the native p95 latency ratio. Circles denote reactive policies, triangles VLAs, squares video WAMs, and the star FoveaWAM. OpenWAM-alpha (off) is outside the selected 0-200 ms range.
